# Draft cover letter

Dear Editor,

Please consider the enclosed manuscript, “An Exact Quotient--Fiber Certificate
for One Local Marginalization in Four-Dimensional \(SU(2)\) Heat-Kernel
Lattice Gauge Theory.”

The paper proves a restricted finite-block theorem. Rooted spanning-tree gauge
gives exact Haar measure accounting on a side-two four-dimensional block.
Exact arithmetic identifies a 51-dimensional retained space and
357-dimensional fiber and certifies a curvature floor. Analytic quaternion and
heat-kernel estimates then yield uniform conditional log-concavity and a
quantitative Hessian bound after one exact local marginalization. Two
independent standard-library arithmetic kernels accompany the proof.

The manuscript does not claim repeated renormalization, continuum
construction, or a Yang--Mills mass gap. Its contribution is an explicit,
auditable interface theorem for a constructive finite-block calculation. The
work is original, is not under consideration elsewhere, and all authors will
approve the submitted version.

Sincerely,

[Author name and affiliation]
